route.name: Right: preloads, corner pick, LEFT volley from the scoring end, wall FLOWER, park

Right: preloads, corner pick, LEFT volle.note: RoboDux, from video (Kentwood Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. Path traced against a 12 in floor grid projected from the four FLOWER posts, every 1-2 s, +-4-6 in (worse at the far end). Start (51, 8) facing 90 at the audience end, beside our RIGHT_START, in every match. Preloads at the AUDIENCE CELL: first ball ~0.9 s (0.4-1.5), last ~2.1 s (1.4-2.2); its own preloads tip it, read up ~4.5 s (alliance AUTO TIP 8/8). Seen in Q-29, Q-34, M-3, M-10 (parked in all four, FTCScout P5). Picks at the pieces by the audience-wall corner (10, 13) until ~9.3 s, drives up the red-wall edge of the HIVE (x~46) to the scoring end and stops at ~(46, 122), between our LEFT_AUTO_OFFSET and LEFT_AUTO_HIVE, ~11.5-17.6 s, shooting the LEFT CELL (balls seen in Q-29; LEFT tipped as it left in M-3; low-medium on the volley's times). Then the red-wall FLOWER (12, 58) ~20-22.5 s and the LOADING ZONE (13, 101) by ~25 s (24-27.5); in Q-29 it also fired from the park at 25-28 s. An earlier read put the scoring-end stop under the HIVE: the 50 in CELLs hide a robot behind them from the audience camera. Heading CAN'T TELL after the start (faces 90 at the start, red '10255' panel toward the camera); later h values are placeholders.

route.name: Right corner: two volleys, wall FLOWER, park

Right corner: two volleys, wall FLOWER,.note: Wayland, from video (Kentwood Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. Path traced at 15 fps in Q-20, Q-4, M-4, Q-25, M-2, M-9, Q-15, M-7 (floor mapped from the four FLOWER posts per clip, every trace drawn back on the video; +-4-6 in); the same Auto in all of them. Q-33 not traced (its partner blocked the FLOWER; it parked late, ~24.5 s). Starts in the corner of the red and audience walls, (10, 12) median; pulls up to its launch spot (26, 13.5) by ~1.4 s and stands there to ~8.0 s; first volley at the AUDIENCE CELL ~3-6.5 s (M-4, its TIP swung 8-10 s) / ~5-8 s (Q-4) (moderate). Drives straight up x~30 to y~50 and slides left to (16, 51), ~16 in off the red-wall FLOWER, 11.0-12.3 s (read as a pick; count not visible); back right to ~(31, 51) and straight down to the launch spot by ~15 s; second volley there, leaving at ~17.9 s (Q-4 measured 17.5-20.0; low-moderate). Then straight up x~26-30 and diagonally to the LOADING ZONE, parked at (15, 93) by ~21.0 s (19.8-24.1), ~6 in from our RIGHT_PARK. Bends fit the eight traces to a median 0.7-1.4 in. FTCScout: AUTO PARK 9/9; alliance AUTO TIP 4/9. Heading: it never visibly turns (red number panel toward the audience camera throughout), but which end is its front is CAN'T TELL; h 90 is a placeholder.

Right: preloads + park.note: OverClucked, from video (Coloma Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. The same Auto in all eight: Q-3, Q-9, Q-19, Q-26, Q-39, M-4, M-7, M-10 (high). Path traced frame by frame at 15 fps in all eight (camera mapped by the field corners, +-3 in): starts against the audience wall at (31.4, 8.7) (spread under 2 in), ~24 in toward the red wall from our RIGHT_START. Three preloads at the AUDIENCE CELL: first ball median 3.2 s (1.5-4.0), last ball 3.8 s (2.2-4.8); its CELL tipped in 4/8 (Q-19, Q-26, Q-39, M-10), TIP lag (last ball to CELL settled) ~4.3 s. Leaves at 6.0 s (4.7-7.2), drives dead straight up x=32 to y~62 in ~1.1 s, then cuts diagonally to the red wall, touching it at ~(9, 99) and settling at (15, 98) (end spread +-4 in), parked 2.3 s after leaving (8.2 s median, 6.9-9.4), then still to 30 s. No FLOWER picks. FTCScout: LEAVE and AUTO PARK 8/8. Heading CAN'T TELL (square open-box robot; it does not visibly turn): h 90 is a placeholder.
